examples.sql: SELECT TOP 20 Name, IFNULL(FavoriteColors,$LISTBUILD('No Preference'),FavoriteColors) AS ColorChoice FROM Sample.Person
SELECT IFNULL(NULL,99) AS NullGen,{fn IFNULL(NULL,99)} AS NullODBC
SELECT IFNULL(33,99) AS NullGen,{fn IFNULL(33,99)} AS NullODBC
SELECT Name, IFNULL(FavoriteColors,'No Preference') AS ColorChoice FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name, IFNULL(FavoriteColors,'No Preference',FavoriteColors) AS ColorChoice FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name, IFNULL(FavoriteColors,'No Preference','Preference') AS ColorPref FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name, {fn IFNULL(FavoriteColors,$LISTBUILD('No Preference'))} AS ColorPref FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name, {fn IFNULL(FavoriteColors,'No Preference')} AS ColorChoice FROM Sample.Person
SELECT Name,FavoriteColors,Age FROM Sample.Person WHERE 21 > IFNULL(FavoriteColors,Age) ORDER BY Age
SELECT TOP 20 Name, IFNULL(FavoriteColors'No Preference',FavoriteColors) AS ColorChoice FROM Sample.Person
